Package com.userservice.app.model

Class MaritalStatus

java.lang.Object
com.userservice.app.model.MaritalStatus
@Entity public class MaritalStatus extends Object
Represents a marital status entity within the system.

This class maps to the "marital_status" table in the database and defines the MaritalStatus entity. Each marital status is identified by a unique ID and represented by an enumerated value of MaritalStatusName.

The MaritalStatus entity includes:

  • id: The unique identifier for the marital status (primary key), automatically generated.
  • name: The name of the marital status, stored as an enumerated value of MaritalStatusName.

Key features:

  • Uses Jakarta Persistence annotations for entity mapping and auto-generated ID.
  • Employs Lombok annotations to streamline code by automatically generating getters, setters, and constructors.
  • Represents the marital status using the MaritalStatusName enumeration, ensuring a controlled set of status values.

Constructors:

  • No-args constructor for default initialization.
  • All-args constructor for initializing with a specific marital status name.
